DownloadModal.title: Release Notes & Download
DownloadModal.release_title: Release v3.0.0: A Class Store — TikTok Live x Roblox Interactive System
DownloadModal.release_intro: A Class Store — TikTok Live is officially launched!
DownloadModal.release_sub: A program to connect TikTok Live to the Interactive system in Roblox games in real-time!
DownloadModal.warning_body: This .exe program is only a connection bridge. It cannot be used without a Key. You must purchase a Game Whitelist from the website before the system can be activated.
DownloadModal.f1_d: Unlock the limits of live streaming! The system acts as a bridge to take live events to control and play with the Interactive system in your Roblox game in real-time.
DownloadModal.f2_d: Modern Dark Theme interface, beautiful, easy on the eyes, smooth performance, and low resource usage.
DownloadModal.f3_d: Stream data from your live second by second, detecting all important events gifts.
DownloadModal.f4_d: Authentication via our Middleware. The system automatically binds to your device (Device ID) for safety and stability.
DownloadModal.safety_body: We guarantee that the program is 100% safe, with no embedded viruses, malware, or malicious scripts. It only receives data from TikTok Live and forwards it via the {name} API.
DownloadModal.safety_note: (Note: Since the program is not commercially registered with Microsoft, Windows SmartScreen may warn of an 'Unknown Publisher' on first launch. This is normal for .exe files; click More info -> Run anyway.)
DownloadModal.how_to_buy_step1: Go to our main website: https://www.aclassstore.com/
DownloadModal.how_to_buy_step2: Purchase the Game Whitelist (Interactive) you want.
DownloadModal.how_to_buy_step3: With every purchase, you will receive a personal Key to unlock the program.
DownloadModal.setup_step1: Go to the Assets section at the bottom.
DownloadModal.setup_step3: Double-click to open (If Windows warns, click More info -> Run anyway).
DownloadModal.setup_step4: Enter the Key from the website into the program.
DownloadModal.setup_step5: Click START — The system will start streaming data to your Roblox game immediately!
DownloadModal.footer_contact: If you encounter any issues or have questions, contact us via our page or the {name} website directly.
DownloadModal.usage_warning_intro: After receiving and activating your Key, please avoid pressing the Start and Stop buttons repeatedly within a short period of time.
DownloadModal.usage_warning_interval: It is strongly recommended to leave a reasonable interval between each start and stop operation.
DownloadModal.usage_warning_detection: Frequent starting and stopping may be detected by TikTok as unusual behavior and could be interpreted as automated bot activity.
DownloadModal.usage_warning_gift_issue: If this happens, your account may be unable to retrieve gift data and other live event information properly.
DownloadModal.usage_warning_system_effect: This will affect the overall functionality of the system, including the display of gifts and event triggers within your Roblox map.
DownloadModal.usage_warning_disclaimer: The seller shall not be held responsible for any issues or damages resulting from improper use that does not follow the above recommendations.
